title: Prayer
introduction: Prayer is conversation with God - the heart of our relationship with him. Jesus himself prayed regularly and taught his disciples to pray. We can come to God with everything - thanksgiving, requests, needs, and praise. He hears and answers.

sections.title: The Lord's Prayer
sections.description: Jesus taught this prayer to his disciples as a pattern for all prayer life.

sections.title: Pray Without Giving Up
sections.description: Jesus encourages us to be persistent in prayer.

sections.title: Pray in Jesus' Name
sections.description: We have access to the Father through Jesus.

sections.title: The Spirit's Help in Prayer
sections.description: The Holy Spirit helps us when we do not know what to pray for.

sections.title: The Power of Prayer
sections.description: Prayer works - the prayer of a righteous person has great power.
